items.title: Cava Rises on Sales; CoreWeave Sores on AI Outlook | Stock Movers
items.summary: On this episode of Stock Movers: - Cava (CAVA) is also rising this morning as sales jumped with Americans flocking to Pita Chips, Salmon, and other Mediterranean-diet oriented foods. - Super Micro (SMCI) is giving a sales outlook that topped even the rosiest projections. That along with Coreweave's report is sending markets higher. - CoreWeave (CRWV) is soaring after booming AI demand bolstered the company's revenue outlook. Nebius (NBIS) is also up this morning with earnings coming out.
